tool_args.rationale: The endpoint-matched history gap and transient lag favor a coupled memory ODE. The pilot already brackets the target horizon of 0.45; the uncertainty is in the dynamics, not horizon coverage. Acquire the fine trajectory batch to better distinguish memory decay from coupling before fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter coupled memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast endpoints with similar single-switch histories provide too little independent leverage to separate the memory time constant from the coupling strength. The reconstructed initial memory also depends on that time constant.
A model driven only by the current input and state cannot explain the reported gap between endpoint-matched histories.
It tests a sink-gradient branch rather than the unresolved memory dynamics.
